purpose: Teach: キッカケ/曇っ/わるい/じつに/ていねい/いまどき/ことさら/べつに

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店を始めたキッカケって、お友達の一言だったよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you started the shop because of something a friend said, didn't you?
lines.style: Soft, curious. Gentle lean forward. Aoi's gaze held for a moment — not probing, but genuinely interested in what shaped her. Warm and steady.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、空が曇ってきたわね、雨対策しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: The sky's getting cloudy. We should get ready for rain.
lines.style: Practical attention turning to the practical. Not worried — just noticing what needs doing. Light, matter-of-fact. A small care wrapped in efficiency.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にわるい印象を与えないようにね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Just be careful we don't give our customers a bad impression, okay?
lines.style: Gentle guidance, not criticism. Soft undertone of caring about how Aoi comes across. No edge — just a quiet reminder from someone who notices these things.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、じつに好評だったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu really did go over well, didn't it?
lines.style: Warmth with a trace of pride. Reflecting back something Aoi accomplished. Unhurried — letting the moment settle. Genuine pleasure in her company's success.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様への対応はていねいにしましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Make sure you take care with how you treat our customers, all right?
lines.style: Tender reinforcement. Not hovering — present and attentive. The voice of someone who knows what good care looks like and wants Aoi to see it too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、いまどきはキャッシュレス決済が増えてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Cashless payments are really going up these days.
lines.style: Observational, almost thinking aloud. A shift in attention to how things are changing. Thoughtful, quiet — noticing trends without alarm. Just taking it in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ことさら丁寧にお見送りしてるお客様、覚えてる?メイちゃん
lines.en: Do you remember that customer you were especially careful saying goodbye to?
lines.style: Curious and warm. Asking gently — there's something in the memory she's reaching for. The question lands with care, not as interrogation but as something shared between them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューが売れなくても、べつに気にしないで、メイちゃん
lines.en: Don't worry if the new menu doesn't sell as much, okay? It's fine.
lines.style: Reassuring, close. Reaching out with warmth — softening any disappointment before it settles. The voice of someone who knows worry and wants to ease it away. Tender but matter-of-fact.
